comment: The particle A input and the four particle outputs carry either audio or control voltages depending on the AUDIO/CONTROL button, so they are left without a family. Parameters 5, 6, 12 and 13 and inputs 6 and 7 exist in the code for an unreleased feature and have no position on the panel, so they are left out. SetMinimumEnergy puts every particle at rest with zero velocity at startup and after a crash, so with nothing patched to the particle A input the outputs are constant.
